title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - EnergyConstraint
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/EnergyConstraint. The energy constraint described in the Allowed Limit Range or Power Limit.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnergyConstraint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

allowedLimitRange.description: Relationship. This property indicates the various AllowedLimitRanges or PowerLimits that this PowerConstraint object consists of. Relationship to AllowedLimitRange.

rangeBoundary.description: Relationship. Boundaries of the power range of this PEBC.AllowedLimitRange. The CEM is allowed to choose values within this range for the power envelope for the limit as described in limit_type. The start of the range shall be smaller or equal than the end of the range. Relationship to NumberRange.

hasLowerAveragePower.description: Property. The lower average power associated with this Energy constraint.

hasUpperAveragePower.description: Property. The upper average power of an Energy constraint of a Power Envelope profile.

hasStartTime.description: Property. The moment this constraint becomes valid.

hasEndTime.description: Property. The moment until which this constraint is valid. ISO 8601 duration (e.g. 'PT30M').
